required_outcomes: Chases the landlord for a confirmed start date from his contractor, Riverside Services, mentioning that the tenants were told around 19 November and nobody has attended.
Replies to the tenant honestly: the works are being done by the landlord's own contractor, no start date is confirmed yet, and when he will next be updated.
Keeps the request on hold waiting for the landlord or provider with a short review date (or a dated follow-up).
acceptable_alternatives: Calling or messaging Freya at Riverside Services directly for a date as well as, or instead of, the landlord, provided no instruction or payment goes through the agency.
Asking the tenant for photos of the hedge over the path to pass to the landlord.
positive_behaviours: Tells the landlord the hedge now obstructs the side path, so cutting it back should come first.
Mentions that the neighbour at number 44 reported the same issue and will be kept informed too.
red_flags: Giving the tenant a start date that no one has confirmed.
Escalating to a human over a routine status chase.
prohibited_actions: Assigning an agency contractor to cut the hedge or clear the garden in parallel.
Approving any quote or payment through the agency.
critical_failures: Telling the tenant the works are booked for a specific date that does not appear anywhere in the case.
